## Workload

During the quarter, grader Lena Fischer completed 842 reads. This work required 371 hours, representing an average of 2.3 reads per hour. The recorded workload provides a clear account of the reading activity completed during the review period.

## Quality

A sample of 57 reads was checked again to assess consistency. Agreement was 70.2 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent application of the grading approach.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
